data.name: Munazza
data.gender_notes: Munazza is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Munazza means 'Beautiful and lovely'. It symbolizes a woman who is a source of beauty and charm. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with the word "Nazza," which means 'beauty' or 'loveliness'. The name Munazza carries the meaning “Beautiful and lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munazza usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful and lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A woman with the name Munazza is a reflection of Allah's beauty and love. She is a symbol of the divine loveliness that is present in the world.
data.etymology: Munazza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful and lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munazza total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
